title: The Elements of Typographic Style
author: Robert Bringhurst
note: A book that made me look at every letter twice.

title: Grid Systems
author: Josef Müller-Brockmann
note: The Swiss bible. I keep it on the desk, not the shelf.

title: Interaction of Color
author: Josef Albers
note: Colour is the most relative medium in art.

title: Ways of Seeing
author: John Berger
note: Changed how I read images forever.

title: Thinking with Type
author: Ellen Lupton
note: Gave to every junior on my team.

title: The Design of Everyday Things
author: Don Norman
note: Affordances everywhere once you notice them.

title: S, M, L, XL
author: Rem Koolhaas
note: Heaviest book I own. Worth the shelf sag.

title: Just My Type
author: Simon Garfield
note: A love letter to fonts, and their gossip.

title: Dieter Rams: As Little Design as Possible
author: Sophie Lovell
note: Less, but better. Ten principles I re-read.

title: The Vignelli Canon
author: Massimo Vignelli
note: If you can design one thing, you can design everything.

title: Hegarty on Creativity
author: John Hegarty
note: There are no rules. Except this one.
